name: It Takes 2
artist: Rob Base and DJ E-Z Rock

artist_ref.name: Rob Base and DJ E-Z Rock

podcast.body: This 1988 song prominently samples Lyn Collins' 1972 track "Think (About It)." The use of Collins' funk sound in "It Takes 2" demonstrates how hip hop artists integrated elements from earlier funk and R&B records into their own productions. "you will hear it takes 2 by Rob Base and DJ Easy Rock from 1988."
